name: devtool
description: Browser DevTools extension for DriftJS register VM reactivity engine

scripts.build: pnpm run build:firefox && pnpm run build:chrome
scripts.build:firefox: node ../scripts/assets/copy.js && TARGET=firefox vite build && node ../scripts/devtools/package.js firefox
scripts.build:chrome: node ../scripts/assets/copy.js && TARGET=chrome vite build && node ../scripts/devtools/package.js chrome
